scope: Merge modules into a complete registered study protocol; this file alone is not a run protocol.
limitations: Declared sources and lags require runtime auditing.
deployment includes future policy effects through online learning.
No planner, model, or memory module is implemented by this template.

modules.update_clock: one recurrent arrival per real environment transition; gradient clock separately registered
modules.objective: Maintain history needed for the registered predictive/control target
modules.measure: History intervention response and complete-lifetime raw reward; decoding alone is insufficient

modules.update_clock: after_transition for learning; decision_time for read-only simulation queries
modules.objective: Predict registered reward/continuation/value-relevant outcomes using legal observed data
modules.measure: Held-out multi-step value error, shift adaptation and downstream full-lifetime reward

modules.update_clock: bounded simulations before each real action; persistent model snapshot fixed during each search
modules.objective: Improve the declared expected external-return decision objective under the model
modules.measure: Matched-data and matched-compute return; decision latency; model exploitation error

modules.update_clock: one deployed action per actual decision event; learner writes separately registered
modules.objective: Maximize registered full-lifetime raw external reward
modules.measure: Complete-lifetime score, failures, adaptation and resource use

modules.objective: Check whether the task/model/planning opportunity exists
modules.measure: Diagnostic opportunity only; never counted as a deployable method
